##### Project general facts

Kingdom Gate is a modern residential tower in the heart of Al Furjan, designed to elevate contemporary urban living. With its clean architectural lines, vertical emphasis, and refined visual identity, the development offers a sophisticated environment that balances style with comfort. Fully furnished residences and thoughtfully planned layouts create an atmosphere of ease, allowing residents to enjoy bright, open spaces that support a seamless daily rhythm.

Inside, Kingdom Gate offers a curated mix of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, along with distinctive duplex penthouses. Each home emphasizes natural light, smart spatial planning, and refined detailing to ensure a harmonious living experience. The tower integrates retail on the ground floor, lifestyle amenities on the podium level, and residential floors from levels 2 to 15, creating a cohesive community that merges convenience with contemporary elegance.

All apartments come fully furnished, featuring modern kitchen appliances and interiors designed with refined finishes, soft textures, and warm, contemporary tones. The materials throughout the building emphasize quality and longevity, enhancing both the tactile and visual experience of each space. Elegant lighting, clean surfaces, and carefully selected fixtures contribute to an atmosphere of understated luxury.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Furjan is a residential community situated in close proximity to Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR), and other popular areas in Dubai. It covers an area of approximately 560 hectares and consists of both villas and apartment buildings, offering a diverse range of housing options for residents.

The community is known for its well-planned infrastructure and thoughtfully designed properties. It features a mix of architectural styles, including Arabic, Mediterranean, and contemporary designs, creating a visually appealing and diverse atmosphere.

In terms of amenities, Al Furjan offers a range of facilities to enhance the quality of life for its residents. These include landscaped parks, playgrounds, fitness centers, swimming pools, sports courts, and cycling and jogging tracks. There are also retail centers within the community that provide convenient access to shopping, dining, and other essential services.
